任一侧为空（NaN）结果即为空，比较条件不成立。: If either side is empty (NaN) the result is empty and the comparison is false.
在主周期上逐根运算；自身写 timeframe 不生效，要高周期的量就把 tim: Computed bar by bar on the primary timeframe; a timeframe on this node has no effect. For a higher-timeframe quantity, put timeframe on the operand indicator.
量价配合的累积指标，判断资金流向与主力意图。: Cumulative price-volume indicator used to judge money flow and the intent of large players.
A/D 线在横盘震荡市中会频繁发出错误信号，背离后可能继续背离，盲目抄底会被埋: In sideways markets the A/D line gives frequent false signals; a divergence can keep diverging, and bottom-fishing on it alone gets punished.
极端行情（如连续涨停/跌停）时，A/D 线可能失真，因为价格被锁在极值附近: In extreme moves (e.g. consecutive limit-up/limit-down days) the A/D line can be distorted because price is pinned at the limit.
A/D 线是累积指标，数值本身没有固定范围，不同股票不能直接比较，只能看自身趋势: A/D is cumulative and has no fixed range; values are not comparable across stocks. Use only its own trend and divergences.
两个操作数逐根相加。: Adds two operands bar by bar.
ADX 只测强弱不测方向，单独看 ADX 上升就买卖会两头挨打: ADX measures strength, not direction; trading on a rising ADX alone loses both ways.
ADX 在趋势末期可能仍很高，但价格已到顶/底，容易追高或杀跌: ADX can stay high late in a trend while price is already topping or bottoming, which invites chasing.
参数周期太短（如 7）会导致 ADX 频繁跳动，假信号增多: A very short period (e.g. 7) makes ADX jumpy and adds false signals.
ADX 平滑周期；省略时使用与 diPeriod 相关的默认构造。: ADX smoothing period; when omitted, a default derived from diPeriod is used.
DMA 平行线差 · AMA: DMA difference of moving averages · AMA
人气指标：开盘后的多空力量。: Sentiment indicator: buying vs selling pressure relative to the open.
开盘价被操纵（如集合竞价异常）时失真: Distorted when the open is manipulated (e.g. an abnormal call auction).
衡量价格创N日新低的强度，判断下跌趋势是否持续。: Measures how recently price made an N-bar low, i.e. whether a downtrend persists.
在横盘震荡行情中，Aroon Down 会频繁在 0-100 之间乱跳，产生大量: In sideways markets Aroon Down jumps between 0 and 100 and produces many false signals.
Aroon Down 只反映「新低」的时效性，不反映跌幅大小——连续小阴线也能让: Aroon Down reflects how recent the new low is, not how big the decline is; a run of small down bars keeps it high.
参数 N 选太小（如 10）会过于敏感，容易追在短期低点；选太大（如 50）则反: A small N (e.g. 10) is over-sensitive and buys short-term lows too eagerly; a large N (e.g. 50) reacts too slowly.
衡量趋势的强弱和持续性，通过时间位置判断方向。: Trend strength and persistence from the timing of highs and lows.
在横盘震荡市中，Aroon 振荡器会频繁穿越 0 轴，产生大量假信号，让你反复止: In sideways markets the oscillator crosses 0 often, producing false signals and repeated stop-outs.
它只考虑最高价和最低价的位置，忽略收盘价，所以极端影线可能误导判断: Uses only the positions of highs and lows and ignores the close, so extreme wicks can mislead.
参数周期 N 太小时，指标过于敏感，噪音多；太大时，反应迟钝，错过最佳入场点: A small N is noisy; a large N reacts late and misses entries.
衡量价格创N日新高的速度，判断上升趋势强弱。: Measures how recently price made an N-bar high, i.e. the strength of an uptrend.
横盘震荡时 Aroon Up 会频繁上下穿越 50，产生大量假信号: In sideways markets Aroon Up crosses 50 frequently and produces false signals.
指标只看「创新高」不看幅度，如果价格缓慢爬升但总创新高，Aroon Up 依然很: It looks at new highs, not their size: a slow grind that keeps making highs keeps Aroon Up high and hides pullback risk.
平均真实波幅，衡量股票的「日均波动幅度」，是风控和止损的基石。: Average True Range: the typical bar-to-bar range of a stock; the basis of risk control and stops.
ATR 不指方向，单独用毫无意义，必须配合趋势指标: ATR has no direction and is meaningless alone; combine it with a trend indicator.
暴跌或大涨后 ATR 会被拉得很高，用它做止损可能被「震出场」: After a crash or spike ATR is inflated, and stops based on it may get shaken out.
不同股票的 ATR 数量级差异极大（茅台 vs 创业板小盘股），跨标的策略要用: ATR magnitudes differ hugely across stocks; for cross-sectional strategies normalise it as ATR%.
平均真实波幅 ATR 的周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越: ATR period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).
ATR 除以价格，标准化波动率，方便跨股对比。: ATR divided by price: normalised volatility comparable across stocks.
低价股（比如 1 元以下）的 ATR% 可能虚高，因为价格基数小，实际波动金额不: ATR% of very low-priced stocks (e.g. below 1 yuan) can look inflated because the price base is small.
停牌后复牌的股票 ATR% 会突然暴增，不要直接用来止损，等几天稳定再说: ATR% spikes right after a trading halt ends; wait a few days before using it for stops.
ATR% 本身不指方向，不能单独做买卖信号，必须配合趋势指标: ATR% has no direction and is not a trading signal on its own; combine it with a trend indicator.
ATR / 收盘价 × 100，用于跨品种波动过滤。: ATR / close × 100, for volatility filtering across instruments.
衡量最近5根K线与34根K线动量差值的震荡指标。: Oscillator: momentum of the last 5 bars minus that of the last 34 bars.
横盘震荡时柱子频繁变色，容易产生假信号，胜率很低: In sideways markets the histogram flips colour often; false signals and a low hit rate.
零轴附近柱子很矮时信号意义弱，容易追高或杀跌: Near the zero line, short bars carry little meaning and invite chasing.
AO只看价格中位，忽略成交量，单用容易被骗线: AO uses only the median price and ignores volume; used alone it is easy to fool.
3/6/12/24 日均线的平均，价格在其上方偏多、下方偏空。: Average of the 3/6/12/24-day moving averages; price above it leans bullish, below leans bearish.
本质是均线，震荡市反复穿越: It is a moving average at heart and is crossed back and forth in ranges.
价格偏离 N 日均线的百分比，偏离过大常有回归。: Percent deviation of price from its N-day moving average; large deviations often revert.
强势股可以长时间保持高乖离，单独做空 / 卖出容易卖飞: Strong stocks can stay far above their average for a long time; shorting or selling on BIAS alone exits too early.
不同波动率的股票合理区间不同，阈值要按股票调: Reasonable ranges differ with volatility; tune thresholds per stock.
布林带的下轨，通常代表超卖区域或支撑位。: Lower Bollinger band, usually read as oversold territory or support.
单边下跌行情中，价格会沿着下轨持续下行，此时抄底会被套牢: In a one-way decline price rides down the lower band; bottom-fishing there gets trapped.
下轨只是统计边界，不是绝对支撑，价格可以长期在下轨下方运行: The lower band is a statistical boundary, not hard support; price can stay below it for long.
横盘震荡时，价格反复触碰下轨但无实质反弹，容易产生假信号: In sideways markets price touches the lower band repeatedly without a real bounce, giving false signals.
中轨与标准差计算所用的周期。: Period used for the middle band and the standard deviation.
布林带中轨 = N 周期 SMA，配合上下轨判断「价格是否偏离常态」。: Bollinger middle band = N-period SMA; with the outer bands it shows whether price has left its normal range.
单边强趋势市场，价格会持续沿上轨或下轨运行，用通道反转必死: In strong one-way trends price rides the upper or lower band; trading reversals at the bands fails.
中轨周期太短（< 10）噪声大，太长（> 30）滞后明显，20 是经典折中: A middle-band period under 10 is noisy, over 30 lags; 20 is the classic compromise.
默认 2 倍标准差适合大盘股，小盘股波动大可考虑 2.5-3: The default 2 standard deviations suits large caps; for volatile small caps consider 2.5–3.
布林带中轨 SMA 周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑: Bollinger middle band SMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).
布林带的上轨，代表股价的「压力线」，突破可能意味着强势或泡沫。: Upper Bollinger band: the resistance line; a break above can mean strength or a bubble.
在单边大涨行情中，股价会长时间贴着上轨运行，此时卖出会踏空大段利润: In a strong rally price can hug the upper band for long; selling there misses much of the move.
横盘震荡时上轨会频繁被触碰又回落，容易产生假突破，导致反复止损: In sideways markets the upper band is touched and rejected often, producing false breakouts and repeated stops.
参数设置不当（如周期太短或倍数太小）会导致上轨过于敏感，信号过多: Poor settings (too short a period or too small a multiplier) make the band over-sensitive with too many signals.
布林上下轨之间的宽度占中轨的百分比，衡量波动收敛与扩张。: Width between the upper and lower bands as a percent of the middle band: volatility contraction and expansion.
只说波动大小、不说方向: Measures volatility size only, not direction.
意愿指标：相对昨收的多空力量。: Willingness indicator: buying vs selling pressure relative to the previous close.
当日炸板次数（封住→买一跌破涨停价的跃迁数）。: Number of times the limit-up board broke today (transitions from sealed to bid-1 falling below the limit price).
盘中重启会丢失当日累计（状态在内存），重启后从 0 重新数: An intraday restart loses the running count (state is in memory); counting restarts from 0.
只有进了盘口采集集的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 false，不会误触发: Only symbols in the order-book capture set have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
★ 求值频率目前仍是 bar 收盘（1/分钟），适合做「现在是什么状态」的确认，: ★ Evaluation still happens at bar close (once a minute): good for confirming the current state, not for catching a transition that just happened.
一根 bar 内 撤单额/委托额。真封与假封的分水岭。需逐笔委托/成交。: Cancelled amount / ordered amount within one bar; separates genuine limit-up seals from fake ones. Needs tick-by-tick orders and trades.
只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN.
分母是委托额，冷清时段样本极少、比值跳动剧烈: The denominator is order amount; in quiet periods the sample is tiny and the ratio jumps around.
阈值尚未标定，切勿直接照抄示例里的数字: Thresholds are not calibrated yet; do not copy the numbers in the examples.
一根大阴线吃掉前一根阳线，典型的顶部反转信号。: A large down bar swallows the previous up bar; a classic top-reversal signal.
在震荡市或下跌趋势中出现的看跌吞没，往往只是假信号，容易追空被套: Bearish engulfing in a range or an existing downtrend is often a false signal; shorting it gets trapped.
如果第二根阴线实体不够大（只比阳线实体大一点点），反转成功率会大幅下降: If the second bar's body is barely larger than the up bar's body, reversal odds drop sharply.
必须等收盘确认，盘中看到阴线吞没阳线就入场，容易被尾盘拉升打脸: Wait for the close to confirm; entering intraday on an apparent engulfing gets caught by late rallies.
两根K线组成的看跌反转形态，预示上涨可能结束。: Two-bar bearish reversal pattern suggesting an advance may be ending.
在横盘震荡市中频繁出现，但多数是假信号，盲目卖出会被来回打脸: Frequent in sideways markets, mostly as false signals; selling on it blindly gets whipsawed.
单根形态胜率有限，必须等下一根K线确认（比如跌破孕线最低点）再行动: A single pattern has limited edge; wait for confirmation (e.g. a break of the harami low).
小周期（如5分钟）的孕线噪音极大，尽量在日线或周线使用: On small timeframes (e.g. 5m) harami is very noisy; prefer daily or weekly.
开盘即最高、收盘即最低，没有上下影线，卖方全程主导、价格一路下跌。: Opens at the high and closes at the low with no shadows: sellers in control throughout.
低位恐慌盘也常出现，未必继续跌: Also common in capitulation at lows; it does not guarantee further declines.
实体 ÷ 开盘价 ≥ 它，排除开盘即最高的小阴线。: Body ÷ open must be at least this, to exclude tiny bars that merely open at the high.
一根阴线后出现一根更大的阳线，完全包住前一根，预示上涨。: A larger up bar fully covers the previous down bar, suggesting a rise.
在上涨趋势中或横盘震荡中出现的看涨吞没，信号可靠性大幅降低，容易追高被套: Bullish engulfing inside an uptrend or a range is much less reliable and invites chasing.
两根K线实体都很小（如十字星后的小阳线），吞没形态意义不大，常是假信号: If both bodies are tiny (e.g. a small up bar after a doji) the pattern means little and is often false.
必须等阳线收盘确认，盘中看到阳线覆盖阴线就追入，尾盘可能回落失败: Wait for the up bar to close; buying intraday may fail into the close.
两根K线组成的底部反转信号，预示下跌可能结束。: Two-bar bottom-reversal signal suggesting a decline may be ending.
单根形态胜率不高，尤其在震荡市中经常是假信号，必须等后续确认: Low hit rate on its own, especially in ranges; wait for confirmation.
第二根K线实体越小，反转力度可能越弱，小十字星形态容易失效: The smaller the second body, the weaker the reversal; tiny doji versions often fail.
大趋势向下时，看涨孕线可能只是反弹中继，很快继续下跌: In a major downtrend a bullish harami may only mark a pause before further declines.
开盘即最低、收盘即最高，没有上下影线，买方全程主导、价格一路上扬。: Opens at the low and closes at the high with no shadows: buyers in control throughout.
高位连续光头阳线也可能是加速赶顶: Consecutive marubozu at high levels can also be a blow-off top.
实体 ÷ 开盘价 ≥ 它，排除开盘即最低的小阳线。: Body ÷ open must be at least this, to exclude tiny bars that merely open at the low.
开盘收盘价几乎相同，形态像十字，代表多空力量平衡。: Open and close almost equal, forming a cross: buyers and sellers in balance.
十字星在趋势中途出现时，经常只是「空中加油」，继续原方向，盲目反向操作会被打脸: A doji mid-trend is often just a pause; trading against the trend on it gets punished.
单根十字星信号很弱，必须结合前后K线确认，否则假信号极多: A single doji is a weak signal; confirm with surrounding bars or expect many false signals.
参数「根数」设太大（如5根以上），信号太少，错过行情；设太小（1根），信号太多，: Too many bars (5+) gives too few signals; 1 bar gives too many, mostly noise.
实体相对波幅的比例阈值。: Threshold for body size relative to the bar's range.
长阳 → 小实体 → 长阴收破第一根实体中点，上涨末端的见顶组合。: Long up bar → small body → long down bar closing below the midpoint of the first body: a topping combination.
A 股日线真跳空少，中间那根按「实体不和第 1 根实体重叠」判，比教科书宽: True gaps are rare on A-share daily bars; the middle bar only needs a body that does not overlap the first body, looser than the textbook.
单独当买卖点胜率不高，配合位置（低位 / 高位）和成交量用: Weak as a stand-alone entry or exit; use with location (high/low) and volume.
中间那根的小实体阈值（0.008 = 0.8%）。: Small-body threshold for the middle bar (0.008 = 0.8%).
底部反转的蜡烛形态，像一把锤子。: Bottom-reversal candle shaped like a hammer.
锤子线本身不是买入信号，需要次日确认（比如收阳线或高开），否则可能只是下跌中继: A hammer is not a buy signal by itself; wait for next-day confirmation (an up close or a gap up), or it may be a pause in a decline.
在上涨趋势中出现的锤子线（称为「吊颈线」）反而是见顶信号，新手容易混淆: The same shape in an uptrend is a hanging man, a top signal; beginners confuse the two.
成交量太小或处于横盘震荡区间的锤子线，反转概率很低，容易假突破: Hammers on low volume or inside a range rarely reverse and often fail.
一根带长下影线的小实体K线，预示上涨行情可能反转。: Small body with a long lower shadow, suggesting an uptrend may reverse.
上吊线单独出现时可靠性不高，必须等第二天确认，否则容易被假信号骗: Unreliable alone; wait for next-day confirmation.
在强势上涨中，上吊线可能只是短暂回调，随后继续上涨，过早卖出会踏空: In a strong rally it may be a brief dip; selling early misses the rest of the move.
如果上吊线出现在震荡区间顶部，信号会大打折扣，因为本身就没有明确趋势: At the top of a range the signal is much weaker because there is no clear trend.
底部反转信号，像倒过来的锤子，预示可能见底反弹。: Bottom-reversal signal shaped like an upside-down hammer, suggesting a possible rebound.
单根K线形态可靠性较低，必须等次日确认，否则容易是下跌中继: Single-bar patterns are unreliable; wait for next-day confirmation or it may be a pause in a decline.
上影线越长越好，但如果实体太大或上下影线都长，就不是标准倒锤线: Longer upper shadows are better, but with a large body or long shadows on both ends it is not a proper inverted hammer.
在强势下跌趋势中，倒锤线可能只是短暂反弹，随后继续暴跌: In a strong downtrend it may be only a brief bounce before further declines.
向下跳空形成孤岛，随后向上跳空离开，强烈见底信号。: A gap down forms an island, then a gap up leaves it: a strong bottom signal.
进岛、出岛两个缺口的最小幅度。: Minimum size of the gaps into and out of the island.
孤岛最多多少根 K 线。: Maximum number of bars on the island.
向上跳空形成孤岛，随后向下跳空离开，两边留下缺口，强烈见顶信号。: A gap up forms an island, then a gap down leaves it, with gaps on both sides: a strong top signal.
日线上较少见；缺口阈值过小会把普通跳空算进来: Rare on daily bars; a gap threshold that is too small counts ordinary gaps.
长阴 → 小实体 → 长阳收过第一根实体中点，下跌末端的见底组合。: Long down bar → small body → long up bar closing above the midpoint of the first body: a bottoming combination.
单根K线形态，高位出现长上影预示见顶。: Single-bar pattern: a long upper shadow at a high suggests a top.
流星线单独使用胜率不高，必须等次日确认（如低开或收阴），否则容易被假信号坑: Low hit rate alone; wait for next-day confirmation (a lower open or a down close).
在震荡市中或上涨初期出现，可能只是正常回调，直接卖出会踏空: In a range or early in an advance it may be a normal pullback; selling on it misses the move.
上影线不够长（小于实体2倍）或下影线太长，就不是标准流星线，信号失效: If the upper shadow is short (less than 2× the body) or the lower shadow is long, it is not a proper shooting star.
小实体、上下影线都比实体长，多空拉锯、方向待定。: Small body with both shadows longer than the body: a tug of war with no clear direction.
实体 ÷ 全长 ≤ 它。: Body ÷ full range must be at most this.
连续三根阴线，预示上涨行情可能反转。: Three consecutive down bars, suggesting an advance may reverse.
在下跌趋势中出现的三只乌鸦可能是持续信号，而非反转，容易抄底被套: Inside a downtrend it may signal continuation rather than reversal; bottom-fishing gets trapped.
阴线实体不够大或带有长下影线时，信号可靠性降低，容易假信号: Small bodies or long lower shadows reduce reliability.
单看形态不结合趋势和成交量，胜率可能不足50%: Without trend and volume context the hit rate can be under 50%.
连续三根大阳线，预示上涨趋势强劲。: Three consecutive large up bars, suggesting a strong uptrend.
在连续大涨后的高位出现三白兵，可能是主力拉高出货的陷阱，追高容易被套: After a big run-up it can be a distribution trap; chasing gets trapped.
如果三根阳线实体越来越小或带有长上影线，说明上涨乏力，形态可靠性降低: Shrinking bodies or long upper shadows signal fading momentum and lower reliability.
横盘震荡市中频繁出现类似形态，但很快被阴线吞没，容易造成假突破: In ranges similar shapes appear often and are quickly engulfed, producing false breakouts.
下跌之后两根 K 线最低价几乎相同、先阴后阳，下方有支撑。: After a decline, two bars with nearly equal lows, down then up: support below.
容差太大会遍地命中: Too large a tolerance matches almost everywhere.

在强趋势行情中，CCI会长时间停留在超买或超卖区，过早反向操作会导致巨大亏损: In strong trends CCI can stay overbought or oversold for long; fading it early causes large losses.

高低价差的 EMA 相对 m 根前的变化率。: Rate of change of the EMA of the high-low range versus m bars ago.

CMF 在震荡市中频繁穿越 0 轴，容易产生假信号，最好结合趋势指标过滤: In ranges CMF crosses 0 often; filter it with a trend indicator.
CMF 对成交量异常敏感，如果某天出现极端放量（如乌龙指），指标会瞬间失真: CMF is very sensitive to volume; one extreme volume day (e.g. a fat-finger trade) distorts it.

含当根：close < DAY_LOW 永远不成立，跌破新低请用 DAY_LOW: Includes the current bar: close < DAY_LOW can never hold; for a new-low break use DAY_LOW_BEFORE.
今日在当根之前的最低价（不含当根）；当日首根为空。: Lowest price today before the current bar (excluding it); empty on the first bar of the day.
开盘以来「大单主动买额 − 大单主动卖额」的累积，单位元。: Cumulative large-order aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value since the open, in yuan.

当日首根之后，high 严格高于此前当日最高的根数。: Number of bars after the first bar of the day whose high is strictly above the day's prior high.
当日首根 K 线的开盘价（A 股即集合竞价价）。: Open price of today's first bar (the call-auction price for A-shares).

A 股量比：今日每分钟均量 ÷ 过去 N 日每分钟均量。: A-share volume ratio: today's average volume per minute ÷ the average per minute over the past N days.
FULL_DAY 口径下开盘几分钟量比天然很大（竞价量 + 开盘放量），开盘段选: With FULL_DAY the ratio is naturally huge in the first minutes (auction volume plus the opening burst); for screening near the open use SAME_TIME.
基准取序列里此前多少个完整交易日（停牌日自然跳过）；凑不齐为空。暖机按 N +: Baseline uses this many previous complete trading days in the series (halted days are skipped); empty if not enough. Warm-up counts as N + 2 trading days.
FULL_DAY＝行情软件量比；SAME_TIME＝与过去 N 日同一时刻的累计: FULL_DAY = the volume ratio shown in quote software; SAME_TIME = ratio to cumulative volume at the same time of day over the past N days.
当日分时均价线 ≈ Σ(典型价 × 量) / Σ量。: Intraday average price line ≈ Σ(typical price × volume) / Σ volume.
是近似值：真实分时均价＝成交额 / 成交量。: An approximation: the true intraday average is traded value / volume.
一根 bar 内「大单主动买额 - 大单主动卖额」，单位元。逐笔接入后已切真实计: Large-order aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value within one bar, in yuan. Computed from real tick-by-tick data.
只有进了逐笔订阅集（≤50 只）的标的才有值，其余恒 NaN（比较兜底 fals: Only symbols in the tick-by-tick subscription set (≤ 50) have values; others are always NaN (comparisons fall back to false and never fire).
回测/历史区间在逐笔回放接上前恒 NaN——**不要拿回测结果当验证**: Backtests and historical ranges are always NaN until tick-by-tick replay is connected — **do not treat backtest results as validation**.
单位是元不是手，不同市值股票的绝对值不可横向比较: Units are yuan, not lots; absolute values are not comparable across market caps.
减少滞后性的双指数均线，比普通均线更灵敏。: Double EMA with less lag, more responsive than an ordinary moving average.
在震荡行情中 DEMA 会频繁发出假信号，比普通均线更容易被「左右打脸」: In ranges DEMA gives frequent false signals and whipsaws more than ordinary moving averages.
参数周期太小时（如小于 5），DEMA 几乎紧贴价格，失去平滑意义，反而增加噪音: With a very small period (e.g. under 5) DEMA hugs price, loses its smoothing and adds noise.

档位数取决于行情源能力，只有 L1 的源会退化成 1 档: The number of levels depends on the data source; an L1-only source degrades to 1 level.

不填＝按标的规则（主板 / ST 10、创业板 / 科创板 20、北交所 30）: Empty = use the symbol's rule (main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30); if set, it is used regardless of symbol. Empty when the symbol is unrecognised (no code in the series name) and nothing is set.

夹到 0 不给负数：「还差 −0.1%」不是能用的判据，涨停之上也不存在成交。: Clamped at 0, never negative: 'still −0.1% away' is not a usable condition, and no trades exist above the limit.

标的需在 L2 行情覆盖范围内才有数据，否则该指标恒为空。: The symbol must be within L2 market-data coverage, otherwise the indicator is always empty.

唐奇安通道的中轨线，本质是过去N天的价格中位数。: Middle line of the Donchian channel: the midpoint of the past N bars' price range.
中轨只是价格中心，没有趋势方向判断能力，单独使用容易在震荡市被假突破骗: The middle band is a price centre with no trend direction; alone it is fooled by false breakouts in ranges.
参数周期越大，中轨越平滑，但反应越迟钝，等它给出信号行情可能已经走完: A longer period is smoother but slower; its signal may come after the move is over.
遇到极端行情（如连续涨停/跌停），中轨会严重滞后，完全失去参考意义: In extreme moves (consecutive limit-up/down days) the middle band lags badly and loses meaning.
唐奇安中轨（高低均值）窗口：取当根之前的 N 根，不含当根。: Donchian middle band (mean of high and low) window: the N bars before the current one, excluding it.
当根之前 N 根 K 线最高价的最高值（不含当根），构成通道上沿。: Highest high of the N bars before the current one (excluding it): the upper edge of the channel.
不含当根：5 分钟策略里 period=20 就是「这根 5 分钟收盘突破了前: Excludes the current bar: in a 5-minute strategy, period=20 means 'this 5-minute bar closed above the highest high of the previous 20 five-minute bars'. Most other platforms include the current bar, so values differ by one bar when compared.
横盘震荡时，价格反复突破又跌回上轨，假突破极多，追高容易被套: In ranges price breaks above and falls back repeatedly; many false breakouts, and chasing gets trapped.
N 值太小（比如 5）会频繁触发信号，N 值太大（比如 100）则信号稀少，错过: A small N (e.g. 5) fires often; a large N (e.g. 100) rarely fires and misses moves.
唐奇安通道回溯根数：取当根之前的 N 根，不含当根。: Donchian channel lookback: the N bars before the current one, excluding it.
对近期价格赋予更高权重的均线，比SMA更灵敏。: Moving average that weights recent prices more; more responsive than SMA.

参数设太小（如EMA5）几乎跟价格重合，失去平滑意义，噪音很大: A very small period (e.g. EMA5) nearly follows price, loses its smoothing and is noisy.

结合价格变化与成交量，衡量上涨下跌的难易程度。: Combines price change and volume to measure how easily price moves up or down.
停牌 / 零成交量的根会得到空值: Halted or zero-volume bars give empty values.
现涨幅 − 今日最高涨幅（百分点，≤0）。: Current change − change at today's high (percentage points, ≤ 0).
现涨幅 − 今日最低涨幅（百分点，≥0）。: Current change − change at today's low (percentage points, ≥ 0).
现涨幅 − 开盘涨幅（百分点，分母昨收）。负数＝开盘回落。: Current change − change at the open (percentage points, previous close as denominator). Negative = fell back from the open.
偏离均价线（百分点）: Deviation from the intraday average (percentage points)
(现价 − 分时均价) / 昨收 × 100。: (current price − intraday average price) / previous close × 100.
距 x 分钟最高（百分点）: Distance from the x-minute high (percentage points)
现涨幅 − 最近 x 分钟最高涨幅（百分点，≤0）。: Current change − highest change over the last x minutes (percentage points, ≤ 0).
按交易时间计的最近 x 分钟（不按根数）；窗口不跨日，开盘后不足 x 分钟时起点: The last x minutes of trading time (not a bar count); the window does not cross days, and when fewer than x minutes have passed since the open the start is the previous close. 距 x 分钟最低（百分点）: Distance from the x-minute low (percentage points)

分钟主周期上看到的是前一交易日的值（当天盘后才落库，回测取当天就是前视）。: On a minute primary timeframe you see the previous trading day's value (today's is stored after the close; using it in a backtest would be look-ahead).
财务数据按公告日生效（缺公告日按法定披露截止日）：半年报 8 月才公告，7 月看: Financial data takes effect on its announcement date (or the statutory deadline if missing): half-year reports are announced in August, so in July you still see Q1.

BARRA = 风格因子 z-score；FINA = 季度财务指标；DAILY: BARRA = style-factor z-score; FINA = quarterly financial metrics; DAILY_BASIC = daily valuation fields.
随 source 变化：BARRA = SIZE/VALUE/LIQUIDITY: Depends on source: BARRA = SIZE/VALUE/LIQUIDITY/MOMENTUM/VOLATILITY/QUALITY; FINA = roe/netprofit_yoy/debt_to_assets/...; DAILY_BASIC = pe_ttm/pb/circ_mv/turnover_rate/....
最近一个没回补的缺口离现价有多远（%），负数在下方是支撑、正数在上方是压力。: How far (in %) the most recent unfilled gap is from the current price; negative = below (support), positive = above (resistance).
只看最近的一个缺口，更早的缺口不算: Only the most recent gap counts; earlier gaps are ignored.
分钟线之间的缺口没有意义，日内策略请用日线周期: Gaps between minute bars are meaningless; intraday strategies should use the daily timeframe.
只找这么多根以内的缺口。: Only look for gaps within this many bars.
今开相对昨收的涨跌幅（%），全天恒定。: Today's open versus the previous close (%), constant all day.

同缺口支撑，日内请用日线。: Same as gap support: use daily bars for intraday strategies.
输出是价格（与主序列同一复权口径）；算不出时为空，比较条件不成立。: Outputs a price (same adjustment as the primary series); empty when it cannot be computed, and comparisons are false.
配合规则节点 TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: Use with rule nodes TOUCH / BREAK / RECLAIM / RETEST: {"type":"BREAK","level":{"ind":"name"}}.
回看内最近一个未回补的向上缺口的回补价（缺口前一根的最高价）。: Fill price of the most recent unfilled up gap in the lookback (the high of the bar before the gap).
分钟线之间的缺口没有意义：日内策略请写 timeframe:\"1d\" 用日线: Gaps between minute bars are meaningless: intraday strategies should set timeframe:"1d" to use daily gaps.
输入序列（缺省收盘价）在最近 N 根里的最大值。: Maximum of the input series (close by default) over the last N bars.
含当根，所以「突破前高」要和上一根的值比: Includes the current bar, so a 'break above the prior high' must compare with the previous bar's value.
近 N 根对数收益率的标准差，按周期年化成百分比。: Standard deviation of log returns over the last N bars, annualised per timeframe, as a percentage.
与期权隐含波动率是两回事: Not the same thing as option implied volatility.
比 EMA 更贴近价格、又更平滑的均线。: A moving average that tracks price more closely than EMA yet is smoother.
转向快也意味着震荡市里来回穿越多: Turning quickly also means more crossings in ranges.

延迟线本身不产生买卖信号，必须结合其他指标（如转折线、基准线）使用: The lagging span produces no signal by itself; use it with other components (conversion line, base line).
在横盘震荡市中，延迟线会频繁上下穿越K线，产生假信号: In sideways markets it crosses the bars often and gives false signals.
参数26是默认值，但不同股票或周期可能需要调整，死板用26可能错过信号: 26 is the default; other stocks or timeframes may need adjustment.
一目均衡图中的中期趋势线，类似26日均线。: Medium-term trend line of Ichimoku, similar to a 26-day average.
在震荡市中基准线会频繁被穿越，产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌: In ranges the base line is crossed often; many false signals invite chasing.
基准线滞后性比普通26日均线更明显，因为用了最高最低价，对突发行情反应更慢: It lags more than a 26-day average because it uses highs and lows and reacts slowly to sudden moves.
单独使用基准线效果很差，必须结合转换线、延迟线等一目均衡图其他组件: Weak alone; combine with the conversion line, lagging span and other Ichimoku components.
用两条线画出未来支撑阻力区，一目均衡的核心。: Draws the future support/resistance zone with two lines; the core of Ichimoku.
因为提前平移了 26 根 K 线，所以信号天然滞后——等价格跌破带 A 时，实际: Because it is shifted 26 bars ahead, its signals are inherently late: by the time price breaks span A it has already fallen a lot.
在横盘震荡市里，先行带 A 会频繁被上下穿越，产生大量假信号，新手容易反复止损: In sideways markets span A is crossed both ways often; beginners get stopped repeatedly.
单独用先行带 A 意义不大，必须结合转换线、基准线和延迟线一起看，否则容易误判: Span A alone means little; read it with the conversion line, base line and lagging span.
一目均衡图领先线B，构成未来云层下沿。: Ichimoku leading span B, the lower edge of the future cloud.
先行带B是滞后指标（取过去52天极值平均），在快速单边行情中云层会严重滞后，可能: Span B lags (average of 52-day extremes); in fast one-way moves the cloud lags badly and may show wrong support/resistance.
横盘震荡时云层会变得很宽，价格频繁穿越云层，导致频繁假信号: In ranges the cloud gets wide and price crosses it often, giving false signals.
先行带B画在26天后，意味着你看到的云层是「未来」的，但实际价格可能提前反应，不: Span B is plotted 26 days ahead, so the cloud you see is 'the future', but price may react early; do not wait rigidly for price to touch the cloud.
一目均衡图中的短期趋势线，类似9日均线但更灵敏。: Short-term trend line of Ichimoku, like a 9-day average but more responsive.
在震荡行情中，转换线会频繁上下穿越，导致连续亏损，就像钝刀割肉: In ranges it crosses up and down often, causing a string of small losses.
转换线只看9根K线，对单根异常K线（如涨停/跌停）反应过度，容易给出假信号: It looks at only 9 bars and over-reacts to single abnormal bars (e.g. limit-up/limit-down), giving false signals.
单独用转换线做交易胜率很低，必须结合基准线、云层等其它部分一起看: Low hit rate alone; read it with the base line and the cloud.
一目均衡表转换线（短周期高低均）。: Ichimoku conversion line (mean of short-period high and low).
大盘（默认上证指数）离它的 N 日均线有多远，正数表示在均线上方。: How far the market index (Shanghai Composite by default) is from its N-day average; positive means above it.
均线有滞后：急跌开始的头几天指数可能还在均线上方: The average lags: in the first days of a sharp drop the index may still be above it.
只管开仓，不会替你平掉已有持仓；要跟大盘出场，另在出场条件里加「< 0」: Only gates entries and never closes existing positions; to exit with the market, add '< 0' to the exit condition.
指数日线每天收盘后同步，盘后才有当天值: Index daily bars are synced after each close; today's value exists only after the close.
看哪个指数；默认上证指数。: Which index; Shanghai Composite by default.
指数的 N 日均线。: N-day moving average of the index.
衡量涨停后封板有多「稳」，区分一字板、炸板反复和从未触板。: How firmly a limit-up board holds, separating one-price boards, repeated breaks and never-touched.
limitPct 必须匹配板块：主板 / ST 10、创业板 / 科创板 20、: limitPct must match the board: main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30; a wrong value keeps it at 0 throughout.
需要上一个完整交易日取昨收：序列的第一个交易日为空（2026-09-23 前用窗: Needs a previous complete trading day for the previous close: the first trading day in the series is empty (before 2026-09-23 the window's first open approximated the previous close and gap-up stocks were always 0; fixed).
从未触板的股票恒为 0，不能区分「弱势」与「还没启动」——需 Layer 1 先: Stocks that never touched the limit are always 0, so 'weak' and 'not started yet' look the same; screen a limit-up pool first.
主板 / ST 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30。: Main board / ST 10, ChiNext / STAR 20, Beijing 30.
当前这一帧是否封住（1＝封住，0＝没封）。: Whether the current frame is sealed at the limit (1 = sealed, 0 = not).
回测/历史区间没有盘口上下文，恒 NaN——不要拿回测结果当验证: Backtests and historical ranges have no order-book context and are always NaN — do not treat backtest results as validation.
趋势明确时跟得紧、震荡时变钝的自适应均线。: Adaptive average that follows closely in clear trends and slows down in ranges.
参数多，默认 10/2/30 即可: Many parameters; the default 10/2/30 is fine.
KDJ 的 D 线：K 的再平滑，比 K 慢，用来和 K 比交叉。: KDJ D line: K smoothed again, slower than K, used for K/D crossovers.
单边趋势里 K、D 会长时间钝化在 80 以上或 20 以下，超买超卖信号失效: In one-way trends K and D can stay above 80 or below 20 for long, and overbought/oversold signals fail.
震荡市金叉死叉很多，建议配合趋势过滤（如价格在 MA20 上方才做金叉）: Ranges produce many crossovers; add a trend filter (e.g. only take golden crosses above MA20).
一字板 / 停牌补的平价 K 线最高 = 最低，RSV 无定义，这一根 K 沿用: On one-price limit bars or flat bars filled during halts, high = low and RSV is undefined; K carries over from the previous bar.
最近 n 根的最高价、最低价，用来算 RSV（收盘在区间中的位置）。: Highest high and lowest low of the last n bars, used to compute RSV (where the close sits in the range).
K = RSV 的 m1 日平滑（SMA(RSV, m1, 1)）。: K = RSV smoothed over m1 days (SMA(RSV, m1, 1)).
D = K 的 m2 日平滑（SMA(K, m2, 1)）。: D = K smoothed over m2 days (SMA(K, m2, 1)).
KDJ 的 J 线 = 3K − 2D，最灵敏，可以超出 0~100。: KDJ J line = 3K − 2D, the most sensitive; can go beyond 0–100.
KDJ 的 K 线：收盘价在近期高低区间中的位置（平滑后）。: KDJ K line: where the close sits in the recent high-low range (smoothed).
基于ATR的通道下轨，识别超卖和支撑。: ATR-based lower channel band, for oversold conditions and support.
单边下跌趋势中，价格会贴着下轨一路向下，抄底会被套: In a one-way decline price rides the lower band down; bottom-fishing gets trapped.
参数敏感：ATR倍数太小会频繁触发假信号，太大则失去参考意义: Parameter-sensitive: a small ATR multiplier triggers false signals often, a large one makes the band meaningless.
横盘震荡时，下轨可能被反复穿越，产生无效信号: In ranges the lower band may be crossed repeatedly with no useful signal.
通道宽度为 ATR×倍数，数值越大通道越宽。: Channel width is ATR × multiplier; larger values widen the channel.
基于EMA的通道中轨，配合上下轨判断趋势和波动。: EMA-based middle line of the channel; read with the outer bands for trend and volatility.
中轨本身是滞后指标，EMA周期越大滞后越明显，刚拐头时趋势可能已走完: The middle band lags, more so with longer EMA periods; when it turns, the trend may be over.
在横盘震荡市中，中轨会被反复穿越，产生大量假信号: In sideways markets it is crossed repeatedly and gives many false signals.
单独用中轨意义不大，必须结合上下轨或成交量使用: The middle band alone means little; use it with the outer bands or volume.
基于EMA和ATR的波动通道上轨，用于识别超买和突破。: Upper band of an EMA/ATR volatility channel, for overbought conditions and breakouts.
在单边暴涨行情中，价格会一直贴着上轨走，过早卖出容易踏空: In a runaway rally price rides the upper band; selling early misses the move.
ATR参数太小或倍数太大时，上轨离价格太远，失去参考意义: With a small ATR period or a large multiplier the band is too far from price to be useful.
取任意指标 N 根 K 线之前的值，是构造量价背离、MACD 背离等复合判断的基: Value of any indicator N bars ago; the building block for price-volume or MACD divergences and other composite tests.
LAG 本身不产生信号，必须与比较运算（GT/LT）和其他指标结合才有意义: LAG produces no signal itself; it is meaningful only with comparisons (GT/LT) and other indicators.
N 值越大，等待确认时间越长，信号滞后越严重: Larger N means longer confirmation and more delay.
在 K 线数不足（< N + 指标预热期）时返回 NaN，系统自动视为条件不满足: Returns NaN when there are not enough bars (< N + the indicator's warm-up); the condition is then treated as false.
取 source 指标 N 根 K 线之前的值。N=1 即取上一根 K 线的值。: Value of the source indicator N bars ago; N = 1 is the previous bar.
一根 bar 内 大单成交额/全部成交额。需逐笔成交。注意不是日频因子 SUPE: Large-order traded value / total traded value within one bar. Needs tick-by-tick trades. Not the daily factor SUPER_LARGE_RATIO.
大单金额线是全局固定值，对不同市值的股票严苛程度并不一致: The large-order amount threshold is a global constant, so it is stricter for some market caps than others.
阈值尚未标定，示例数字仅供说明: Thresholds are not calibrated yet; example numbers are illustrative only.
昨收 × (1 − 涨跌幅)，按最小价位取整。: Previous close × (1 − limit), rounded to the tick size.
判定一段时间内是否出现过连板（连续涨停），识别强势股和连板妖股。: Whether a run of consecutive limit-up days occurred in a period: identifies strong stocks and limit-up streak leaders.
涨停板次日高开低走是常见坑，只看连板容易追高被套: Opening high and fading the day after a limit-up is a common trap; chasing on streaks alone gets trapped.
一字板买不进，等开板时往往已经是高位，接盘风险极大: One-price limit boards cannot be bought; by the time the board opens price is usually high and the risk of being the bag holder is large.
市场情绪退潮期，连板股可能补跌更狠，别盲目迷信: When market sentiment ebbs, streak stocks can fall harder than others; do not trust streaks blindly.
按上海时区 trade_date 对齐的日线回看窗口；数据以 md_bars_1: Daily lookback window aligned to trade_date in Shanghai time; data comes mainly from md_bars_1d, with recent gaps backfilled from 1m bars by trade_date.
要匹配的连续涨停根数，例如 3 表示 3 连板。: Number of consecutive limit-up bars to match, e.g. 3 means a 3-day streak.
AT_LEAST：至少 N 连板，3 连板包含 4/5 连板；EXACT：恰好: AT_LEAST: at least N in a row, so a 3-day match includes 4- and 5-day streaks; EXACT: exactly N.
ALLOW_BREAK_AFTER_STREAK：窗口内出现过即可，后面允许断板: ALLOW_BREAK_AFTER_STREAK: occurring anywhere in the window is enough, breaks afterwards allowed; REQUIRE_STREAK_TO_WINDOW_END: still on a streak on the window's last day.
涨停幅度默认按标的板块自动判断（主板 10、创业板/科创板 20、北交所 30，: The limit size is detected from the symbol's board by default (main board 10, ChiNext/STAR 20, Beijing 30; limit price = previous close × (1 + limit) rounded to the cent), so mixed pools need no change. This value is only a fallback when the symbol cannot be recognised — backtests, signals and canvas previews already pass the symbol, so normally leave it empty.
昨收 × (1 + 涨跌幅)，按最小价位取整。: Previous close × (1 + limit), rounded to the tick size.
标的从序列名认，认不出（如部分预览/试跑场景）又没填 limitPct 时为空。: The symbol is recognised from the series name; empty when it cannot be (e.g. some preview or dry-run cases) and limitPct is not set.
复权回测（默认前复权）里最近一次除权之前的日子，昨收是缩放过的，取整后可能与真实: In adjusted backtests (forward-adjusted by default), days before the latest ex-rights date have a scaled previous close; after rounding it may differ from the real limit price by one tick.
衡量线性趋势的「靠谱程度」，值越高趋势越稳。: How reliable a linear trend is; higher means steadier.
R2 只衡量线性关系，对「急涨急跌」的抛物线型趋势会给出低值，容易错过主升浪: R² measures only linear fit; parabolic surges score low, so it can miss the main leg of a rally.
参数周期选得太短（如 5 天），R2 容易忽高忽低，产生大量假信号: A short period (e.g. 5 days) makes R² jumpy and full of false signals.
R2 本身不指示方向，单独用会陷入「趋势很好但方向错了」的尴尬: R² has no direction; alone it can say 'great trend' while the trend is down.
线性回归拟合优度，范围 0-1，越接近 1 趋势越线性。: Goodness of fit of a linear regression, 0–1; closer to 1 means more linear.
用线性回归衡量价格趋势的强度和方向，比均线更灵敏。: Strength and direction of the price trend via linear regression; more responsive than a moving average.
在震荡行情中斜率会频繁正负切换，产生大量假信号，比均线更容易被「左右打脸」: In ranges the slope flips sign often and whipsaws more than a moving average.
斜率对价格突变非常敏感，一根大阳线或大阴线会瞬间改变斜率，容易误导你追涨杀跌: The slope is very sensitive to sudden moves; one big bar changes it at once and invites chasing.
不同周期参数下斜率数值差异很大，不能跨周期直接比较，必须固定参数看相对变化: Slope values differ greatly across periods; do not compare across periods, watch relative change with fixed parameters.
输入序列在窗口内的最小二乘斜率，按均价归一为每根 K 线百分比。: Least-squares slope of the input series over the window, normalised by the mean price to percent per bar.
量化「低位放量承接」的强度：量比 × 下影线/实体，捕捉多方在低位强力护盘的信号: Quantifies buying support at lows: volume ratio × lower shadow / body; captures buyers defending the price.
连续涨停/跌停板时，下影线可能极小甚至为零，承接力数值会失真: During consecutive limit-up/limit-down boards the lower shadow is tiny or zero and the value is distorted.
大盘股和小盘股的承接力数值不可直接比较——流通盘大小影响量比基数: Values are not comparable between large and small caps — free float affects the volume-ratio base.
只看承接力不看价格位置容易误判：高位放量长下影可能是出货而非承接: Ignoring price location misleads: a long lower shadow on high volume at a high can be distribution, not support.
计算量比时使用的历史均量回望根数。5=短线，20=波段。: Lookback (bars) of average volume for the volume ratio. 5 = short-term, 20 = swing.
输入序列（缺省收盘价）在最近 N 根里的最小值。: Minimum of the input series (close by default) over the last N bars.
快慢两条 EMA 的差值，量化趋势动能与转折。: Difference between a fast and a slow EMA; quantifies trend momentum and turns.
横盘市场会频繁金叉死叉，假信号成倍增加: In sideways markets crossovers multiply and false signals double.
MACD 本质是滞后指标，趋势确认时往往已经走了一半: MACD lags; when a trend is confirmed it is often half over.
0 轴附近的金叉死叉效果差，建议结合 0 轴位置过滤: Crossovers near the zero line work poorly; filter by position relative to zero.
快线 EMA 周期；若与 slow 均省略则使用 Ta4j 默认 MACD。: Fast EMA period; if both this and slow are omitted the Ta4j default MACD is used.
慢线 EMA 周期；须大于快线（运行时会自动保证 slow≥fast+1）。: Slow EMA period; must exceed the fast one (the runtime enforces slow ≥ fast + 1).
MACD 柱 = 快慢线差值再平滑，反映动能强弱和背离。: MACD histogram = the difference of the fast and slow lines, smoothed again; shows momentum strength and divergence.
在震荡市里，柱子频繁翻红翻绿，信号密集且虚假，追涨杀跌会被反复打脸: In ranges the histogram flips sign often with dense, false signals; chasing gets whipsawed.
背离信号在单边强趋势中可能连续出现多次「假背离」，价格继续原方向运行: In strong one-way trends divergences can appear several times and fail while price keeps going.
柱子缩短不等于马上反转，只是动能减弱，可能横盘后再加速，过早反向操作会踏空: A shrinking histogram is not an immediate reversal, only fading momentum; price may pause and accelerate again, so fading it early misses the move.
MACD 慢线周期（须大于快线）。: MACD slow period (must exceed the fast period).
用于计算柱（MACD−信号线）的周期。: Period used for the histogram (MACD − signal line).
MACD 的慢线，用于确认趋势和发出买卖信号。: MACD's slow line, used to confirm trends and generate signals.
震荡市中金叉死叉频繁出现，胜率极低，容易反复被割: In ranges crossovers are frequent with a very low hit rate.
信号线滞后于快线，等金叉出现时行情可能已经走了一大半: The signal line lags the MACD line; by the golden cross much of the move may be gone.
单独看信号线容易误判，必须结合快线位置和零轴判断趋势强弱: Reading the signal line alone misleads; use the MACD line's position and the zero line to judge trend strength.
对 MACD 线再取 EMA 的周期（信号线）。: EMA period applied to the MACD line (signal line).
是两个序列逐根比较，不是 N 根内最高——那是 HIGHEST。: Compares two series bar by bar; it is not the highest over N bars — that is HIGHEST.
衡量均线倾斜程度，判断趋势强弱与转折。: How steeply a moving average is tilted: trend strength and turns.
斜率本身波动大，容易频繁发出假信号，尤其在横盘震荡时上下乱窜: The slope itself is volatile and gives frequent false signals, especially in ranges.
参数周期选太短（如 5 日均线+3 根斜率间隔）噪音极大，几乎没法用: Very short settings (e.g. a 5-day MA with a 3-bar slope lag) are too noisy to use.
斜率只反映均线的变化速度，不反映价格位置，高位斜率回落可能是正常调整而非反转: The slope reflects how fast the average changes, not where price is; a falling slope at a high may be a normal correction, not a reversal.
先计算输入序列的 SMA。: First computes an SMA of the input series.
当前均线相对 N 根前均线的百分比变化。: Percent change of the current average versus the average N bars ago.
（最高 + 最低）÷ 2，AO 等指标的输入。: (high + low) ÷ 2; the input to AO and similar indicators.
结合价格与成交量的超买超卖指标，类似成交量加权的 RSI。: Overbought/oversold indicator combining price and volume, like a volume-weighted RSI.
在持续单边牛市中，MFI 可能长期在 80 以上钝化，过早卖出会踏空: In a sustained bull run MFI can stay above 80 for long; selling early misses the move.
MFI 对成交量异常敏感，如果股票突然放量（比如庄家对倒），MFI 会失真: MFI is very sensitive to volume; sudden volume (e.g. wash trades) distorts it.
背离信号在震荡市里准确率较高，但在强趋势中可能反复出现假背离: Divergences work better in ranges; in strong trends they can fail repeatedly.
MFI 典型周期 14。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、: Typical MFI period is 14: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).
是两个序列逐根比较，不是 N 根内最低——那是 LOWEST。: Compares two series bar by bar; it is not the lowest over N bars — that is LOWEST.
衡量下跌动能的强度，与+DI配合判断趋势方向。: Strength of downward movement; read with +DI for trend direction.
在震荡市中-DI和+DI频繁交叉，会产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌: In ranges −DI and +DI cross often and produce many false signals.
单独看-DI没有意义，必须和+DI、ADX一起用，否则容易误判趋势: −DI alone means nothing; use it with +DI and ADX.
参数周期太短（如5以下）会导致-DI过于敏感，噪声多；太长（如30以上）则反应迟: A period under about 5 is over-sensitive and noisy; over about 30 reacts too slowly.
最近一次触及今日最高价到现在过了几分钟。: Minutes since price last touched today's high.
最近一次触及今日最低价到现在过了几分钟。: Minutes since price last touched today's low.
开盘后第几分钟（交易时间，午休连续计时）。: Minute of the session since the open (trading time; the lunch break is skipped).
分钟级阈值要求 1m 主周期；5m 主周期上只能取到 5 的倍数（0、5、10…: Minute-level thresholds need a 1m primary timeframe; a 5m primary timeframe only yields multiples of 5 (0, 5, 10 ...).
当根量 ÷ 过去 N 日同一根（同一「开盘后分钟」）的均量。: Current bar's volume ÷ average volume of the same bar (same minute since the open) over the past N days.
当前收盘与 N 根前收盘之差，衡量涨跌速度。: Current close minus the close N bars ago: speed of the move.

横盘震荡市容易误判，很多看似三角形其实是无趋势的矩形: Easily misread in ranges; many apparent triangles are trendless rectangles.
突破方向不确定，即使形态完美也可能向下假突破，必须等确认: The breakout direction is uncertain; even a perfect pattern can break down falsely, so wait for confirmation.
上下轨收敛程度阈值。: Convergence threshold of the upper and lower lines.
有效突破幅度（占价比例）。默认日线 1.5%（填小数 0.015），留空＝按周期: Valid breakout size (share of price). Default 1.5% on daily (enter 0.015). Empty = scale automatically by timeframe from the daily value by the square root of time (hourly ≈ 1/2, 15m ≈ 1/4, 5m ≈ 1/7, weekly ≈ 2.2×); if set, the given value is used.
三次下探到相近位置都没破，随后突破颈线，比 W 底更扎实的见底形态。: Three dips to a similar level that hold, then a neckline breakout: a sturdier bottom than a double bottom.

中间反弹高点容差。默认日线 8%（0.08），留空＝按周期自动：以日线为基准，按: Tolerance for the middle rebound highs. Default 8% on daily (0.08). Empty = scale automatically by timeframe from the daily value by the square root of time (hourly ≈ 1/2, 15m ≈ 1/4, 5m ≈ 1/7, weekly ≈ 2.2×); if set, the given value is used.
两底价格差上限（占价格的比例，如 0.05＝5%）。留空＝不看价格差，只按「高低: Maximum price difference between the bottoms (share of price, e.g. 0.05 = 5%). Empty = ignore the price difference and judge symmetry by height difference / pattern height (6%–7% differences are common in large patterns and a price cap would miss them).
ZigZag 转折幅度：价格从一个高点（低点）反向走出这么多，才把它认作一个底。: ZigZag reversal size: price must move this far back from a high (low) to count it as a bottom. 两底之间至少隔多少根（头肩：左肩到头、头到右肩各至少一半）；默认 8，挡住两三天: Minimum bars between the bottoms (head and shoulders: at least half each from left shoulder to head and head to right shoulder); default 8, filters out wiggles within two or three days.
颈线突破确认。默认日线 1.5%（填小数 0.015），留空＝按周期自动：以日线: Neckline breakout confirmation. Default 1.5% on daily (enter 0.015). Empty = scale automatically by timeframe from the daily value by the square root of time (hourly ≈ 1/2, 15m ≈ 1/4, 5m ≈ 1/7, weekly ≈ 2.2×); if set, the given value is used.
W 底默认要求中间反弹高点向上突破；成立后统一输出 +1。: Double bottom requires the middle rebound high to break upward by default; a match always returns +1.
三次冲高到相近位置都没过去，随后跌破颈线，比 M 头更强的见顶形态。: Three rallies to a similar level that fail, then a neckline break: a stronger top than a double top.
W 底形态识别，经典反转看涨信号。: Double-bottom recognition, a classic bullish reversal signal.
横盘震荡市中容易形成假 W 底，突破后很快又跌回来，止损一定要设: False double bottoms form easily in ranges and fall back soon after the breakout; always set a stop.
形态识别有主观性，不同参数（如回溯期、容差）可能得到不同结果，别盲目信任: Recognition is subjective; different parameters (lookback, tolerance) give different results, so do not trust it blindly.
当前价格在过去 N 天里的相对位置，0-100 之间。: Where the current price sits within the past N days, 0–100.
横盘震荡时百分位频繁在 0-100 之间来回，容易给出假信号，必须配合趋势指标: In ranges the percentile swings across 0–100 and gives false signals; combine with a trend indicator.
百分位只反映过去 N 天的相对位置，不反映绝对价格高低，牛市里长期在 80 以上: It reflects only the position within the past N days, not absolute price; staying above 80 for long is normal in a bull market, and shorting on it blindly is costly.
窗口期太短（如 5 天）时百分位波动剧烈，信号可靠性差；窗口太长（如 100 天: A short window (e.g. 5 days) is jumpy and unreliable; a long one (e.g. 100 days) reacts too slowly.
当前值在窗口内的百分位，范围 0-100。: Percentile of the current value within the window, 0–100.
分钟级衡量「从近期高点回撤了多少」，用于盘中判断是否接近目标深度（如黄金坑到位）: Minute-level measure of how far price has pulled back from its recent high, for judging intraday whether a target depth (e.g. a golden pit) is reached.
必须跑在分钟级 K 线上；用日线会失真，且 lookbackBars 含义完全不: Must run on minute bars; on daily bars it is distorted and lookbackBars means something else entirely.
lookbackBars 窗口内的「峰值」会随新 K 线刷新，盘中指标值会跳动，: The 'peak' within lookbackBars refreshes with new bars, so the value jumps intraday; avoid narrow thresholds that fire repeatedly.
目标回撤设太小（如 5%）在震荡市里容易频繁达标，产生大量假信号: A small target drawdown (e.g. 5%) is reached often in ranges and gives many false signals.
回看多少根 K 线找峰值 high；1m K 线建议 240（4 小时）。: Bars to look back for the peak high; 240 recommended on 1m bars (4 hours).
回撤到该阈值视为到位，返回值=1.0。: Reaching this drawdown counts as in place, returning 1.0.
用的是上一根 K 线，日线上就是昨日: Uses the previous bar; on daily bars that is yesterday.
前 N 根（不含当根）振幅 ≤ maxRangePct% 时的最高价；振幅超了不: Highest price of the previous N bars (excluding the current one) when their range is ≤ maxRangePct%; empty if the range is larger (not a platform).
不含当根的回看根数。: Lookback bars, excluding the current bar.
前 N 根（最高 − 最低）/ 最低 × 100 不超过它才算平台。: Counts as a platform only if (high − low) / low × 100 over the previous N bars does not exceed this.
前 N 根（不含当根）振幅 ≤ maxRangePct% 时的最低价。: Lowest price of the previous N bars (excluding the current one) when their range is ≤ maxRangePct%.
衡量上涨方向动量的指标，常与-DI配合判断趋势。: Strength of upward movement; usually read with −DI for trend.
在震荡行情中，+DI 和 -DI 会频繁交叉，产生大量假信号，容易追涨杀跌: In ranges +DI and −DI cross often and produce many false signals.
+DI 本身不给出具体买卖点，必须结合 -DI 和 ADX 一起用，单独看容易误: +DI gives no entry or exit itself; use it with −DI and ADX.
参数周期太短（如 7）会导致指标过于敏感，噪声多；周期太长（如 30）则反应迟钝: A short period (e.g. 7) is over-sensitive and noisy; a long one (e.g. 30) reacts too slowly.
上一交易日最后一根 K 线的收盘价。: Close of the last bar of the previous trading day.
上一交易日最高价。: High of the previous trading day.
上一交易日最低价。: Low of the previous trading day.
直接使用K线的开盘、收盘、最高、最低价作为指标。: Uses the bar's open, close, high or low directly as an indicator.
单独看收盘价容易忽略盘中波动，尤其日内交易者需要结合高低价: The close alone ignores intraday swings; intraday traders should consider highs and lows too.
不同股票的价格绝对值差异大，不能直接比较价格高低: Absolute prices differ widely across stocks and are not comparable.
价格序列字段。CLOSE 为默认收盘价，也可取 OPEN/HIGH/LOW。: Price field. CLOSE by default; OPEN/HIGH/LOW also available.
价格突破近期高点，经典追涨信号。: Price breaks above a recent high: the classic momentum-chasing signal.
横盘震荡时频繁假突破，一买就套，胜率很低: In ranges false breakouts are frequent and buyers get trapped; low hit rate.
突破后如果量能不足，容易冲高回落，需要配合成交量验证: Without enough volume a breakout often fades; confirm with volume.
周期选太小（如 5 日）信号太多，选太大（如 60 日）信号太少，容易错过行情: A small period (e.g. 5 days) fires too often, a large one (e.g. 60 days) too rarely.
用于计算突破基准的历史高点窗口，不包含确认 K 线。: Window of past highs used as the breakout reference, excluding the confirmation bars.
连续多少根闭合 K 线有效上破才返回 +1。: Number of consecutive closed bars with a valid break above before returning +1.
CLOSE 使用收盘确认；HIGH_LOW 使用最高价触发。: CLOSE confirms on the close; HIGH_LOW triggers on the high.
相对前高的最小突破比例；0.002 表示至少上破 0.2%。: Minimum break above the prior high; 0.002 means at least 0.2%.
设为 0 关闭；大于 0 时突破距离需达到 ATR 的指定倍数。: 0 disables it; above 0 the breakout distance must reach this ATR multiple.
价格跌破过去N根K线的最低点，经典向下突破信号。: Price falls below the lowest low of the past N bars: the classic downside break.
横盘震荡时，前低频繁被突破又收回，容易反复打脸: In ranges the prior low is broken and recovered often, causing whipsaws.
突破后可能假突破，价格迅速拉回，需要配合确认根数或成交量过滤: Breaks may be false and snap back; filter with confirmation bars or volume.
周期选太大，信号太少；周期选太小，噪音太多: A large period gives too few signals, a small one too much noise.
用于计算跌破基准的历史低点窗口，不包含确认 K 线。: Window of past lows used as the breakdown reference, excluding the confirmation bars.
连续多少根闭合 K 线有效下破才返回 +1。: Number of consecutive closed bars with a valid break below before returning +1.
CLOSE 使用收盘确认；HIGH_LOW 使用最低价触发。: CLOSE confirms on the close; HIGH_LOW triggers on the low.
相对前低的最小跌破比例；0.002 表示至少下破 0.2%。: Minimum break below the prior low; 0.002 means at least 0.2%.
设为 0 关闭；大于 0 时跌破距离需达到 ATR 的指定倍数。: 0 disables it; above 0 the breakdown distance must reach this ATR multiple.

前 N 根的最高价，不含当根。「突破前高」＝ BREAK(level=PRIOR: Highest price of the previous N bars, excluding the current bar. 'Break above the prior high' = BREAK(level=PRIOR_HIGH).
要「N 日前高」就给它写 timeframe:\"1d\"（已收完的日线），或直: For the 'N-day prior high', give it timeframe:"1d" (completed daily bars), or use HIGHEST(timeframe=1d).
前 N 根最低（不含当根）: Lowest of previous N bars (excluding current)
前 N 根的最低价，不含当根。: Lowest price of the previous N bars, excluding the current bar.
N 日内上涨天数占比，反映市场情绪冷热。: Share of up days within N days: how hot or cold sentiment is.
只数涨跌天数、不看幅度，小涨多日与大涨一日同样计 1: Counts up and down days only, ignoring size: many small gains and one big gain each count 1.
近 N 根「收盘 − 开盘」的均值，看阳线多还是阴线多。: Average of (close − open) over the last N bars: whether up bars or down bars dominate.

最近 N 秒的撤单额 / 委托额。: Cancelled amount / ordered amount over the last N seconds.
分母是委托额，撤单本身不进分母——否则撤得越狠比值反而越低。: The denominator is order amount; cancellations are not in it — otherwise heavier cancelling would lower the ratio.
向前回看多少秒。缺省 30 秒是结构性缺省，不是标定过的值。上限由行情侧秒环长度: Seconds to look back. The default 30 is structural, not calibrated. Capped by the market-data second ring length.
最近N秒 大单占比 · L2: Large-order share, last N seconds · L2
最近 N 秒的大单成交额 / 全部成交额。: Large-order traded value / total traded value over the last N seconds.
大单线本身没标定过，占比的绝对值意义有限，先看相对高低。: The large-order threshold is not calibrated; the absolute share means little, compare relative levels first.
最近N秒 主力净额 · L2: Main-force net, last N seconds · L2
最近 N 秒的大单主动买额 − 大单主动卖额，单位元。: Large-order aggressive buy value − aggressive sell value over the last N seconds, in yuan.
金额量级随股票市值差很多，跨标的比较要先归一。: Magnitudes vary greatly with market cap; normalise before comparing across symbols.
最近N秒 主动买卖不平衡 · L2: Order flow imbalance, last N seconds · L2
最近 N 秒的主动买入额与主动卖出额之差占比，取值 [-1,1]。: Aggressive buy value minus aggressive sell value as a share of their sum over the last N seconds, in [−1, 1].
窗口太短会被单笔大单主导，噪声很大；太长又退化成 OFI。标定时先看分布再定。: Too short a window is dominated by single large trades and very noisy; too long degenerates into OFI. Look at the distribution before choosing.
衡量价格变动速度，发现超买超卖和背离。: Speed of price change; finds overbought/oversold conditions and divergences.
ROC 在横盘震荡时频繁穿越 0 轴，会产生大量假信号，让你反复买卖亏手续费: In ranges ROC crosses 0 often, generating many false signals and fee-draining trades.
ROC 只看两个时间点的价格差，容易受单日异常波动影响，比如某天突然拉涨停，RO: ROC compares two points in time only and is distorted by single-day anomalies; a sudden limit-up spikes it without the trend necessarily continuing.
不同股票的波动率不同，统一的阈值（如 ±20）可能完全无效，需要根据历史数据调整: Volatility differs by stock; a fixed threshold (e.g. ±20) may be useless, tune it on history.
上一根收盘之上最近的 step 整数倍（锚在上一根，当根突破时关口不跟着跳）。s: Nearest multiple of step above the previous close (anchored on the previous bar, so it does not jump when the current bar breaks it). step = 0 picks a step from the price magnitude (9.95 → the 10-yuan level).
0＝按价格量级自动（个位价 1 元、十位价 10 元……）。: 0 = automatic by price magnitude (1 yuan for single-digit prices, 10 for double-digit ...).
上一根收盘之下最近的 step 整数倍。: Nearest multiple of step below the previous close.
通过最近 N 期涨跌幅比衡量超买超卖，0-100 区间的震荡指标。: Oscillator (0–100) measuring overbought/oversold from the ratio of gains to losses over N periods.
单边趋势市场 RSI 会长期「钝化」（持续 > 80 或 < 20），不发信号或: In one-way trends RSI stays pinned (above 80 or below 20) and gives no or wrong signals.
短周期 RSI（< 7）噪声极大，假信号频繁，建议至少 9 以上: Short-period RSI (< 7) is very noisy; use at least 9.
单独用 RSI 抄底，在熊市会越买越套——必须配合趋势过滤: Bottom-fishing on RSI alone keeps buying into a bear market; add a trend filter.
RSI 回溯周期；后端与 Ta4j 一致会将结果钳制为至少 2。: RSI lookback; the backend clamps it to at least 2, consistent with Ta4j.
封单额（元）＝买一价×买一量。★ 仅当买一价站上涨停价时才有值，否则 NaN。: Seal amount (yuan) = bid-1 price × bid-1 volume. ★ Has a value only when bid-1 is at or above the limit-up price, otherwise NaN.
封单额的绝对值对不同市值的股票不可横向比较，通常要配 SEAL_RATIO 一起: Absolute seal amounts are not comparable across market caps; usually pair it with SEAL_RATIO.
封单额/当日累计成交额，衡量封板厚度相对换手。: Seal amount / today's cumulative traded value: seal thickness relative to turnover.
分母是近似值（1m bar 汇总），不是交易所口径的累计成交额: The denominator is approximate (aggregated 1m bars), not the exchange's cumulative turnover.
封单额变化率（元/秒，最小二乘斜率）。★ 负值＝撤单出逃的第一信号。: Rate of change of the seal amount (yuan per second, least-squares slope). ★ Negative = the first sign of cancellations and flight.
滑窗帧数是结构性缺省（约 10 秒），尚未标定: The sliding window length (about 10 seconds) is structural and not calibrated.
刚封板或刚回封时样本不足，返回 NaN: Right after sealing or resealing there are too few samples and it returns NaN.
看个股所属概念板块「今天强不强」，用于盘中顺势，不做逆势孤狼。: Whether the stock's concept sectors are strong today, to trade with the sector instead of alone against it.
分钟主周期上它是「昨日板块强度」，不是盘中实时强度（盘中板块数据源尚未接入）。: On a minute primary timeframe it is yesterday's sector strength, not real-time (the intraday sector feed is not connected yet).
依赖同花顺概念数据同步；缺数据时为空，不是「板块弱」而是「没数据」: Depends on synced Tonghuashun concept data; empty means 'no data', not 'weak sector'.
个股归属多个概念，取的是最强概念 z-score，可能掩盖其他概念拖累: A stock belongs to several concepts; the strongest concept's z-score is used, which can hide drag from the others.
最近 N 根收盘价的算术平均，技术分析里最经典的均线指标。: Arithmetic mean of the last N closes; the most classic moving average.
横盘震荡市场会被反复打脸，胜率可能跌到 30% 以下: Ranging markets whipsaw it repeatedly; hit rates can fall below 30%.
周期越大滞后越严重——刚发出金叉时趋势往往已经走了一半: Longer periods lag more — by the golden cross the trend is often half over.
单独用 SMA 容易过拟合到回测期，实盘建议配合成交量或波动率过滤: SMA alone easily over-fits the backtest period; add volume or volatility filters for live use.
简单移动平均周期。用于该指标计算所回溯的 K 线根数（周期越大曲线越平滑、滞后越: SMA period: number of bars looked back (larger is smoother and lags more).
买卖价差相对 mid 的 bps。涨停封死时没有卖盘，本就为 NaN。: Bid-ask spread relative to mid, in bps. NaN when sealed at limit-up because there is no ask.
涨停/跌停封死时恒 NaN: Always NaN when sealed at limit-up or limit-down.
输入序列（缺省收盘价）最近 N 根的标准差，衡量波动大小。: Standard deviation of the input series (close by default) over the last N bars: size of fluctuations.
是价格单位，不同价位的股票不能直接比；要比用 ATR_PCT 或 BOLL 带宽: It is in price units and not comparable across price levels; use ATR_PCT or Bollinger bandwidth to compare.
把 RSI 再做一次随机指标，超买超卖更灵敏。: Applies the stochastic formula to RSI; more sensitive overbought/oversold readings.
在单边趋势中会频繁发出假信号——比如大牛市里一直超买，你卖早了就踏空: Gives frequent false signals in one-way trends — e.g. permanently overbought in a bull market, so selling early misses the move.
参数太短（如 3,3）信号极多，胜率低；参数太长（如 21,21）又失去灵敏优势: Very short settings (e.g. 3,3) fire constantly with a low hit rate; long ones (e.g. 21,21) lose the sensitivity advantage.
底层 RSI 的周期；实现中至少为 2。: Underlying RSI period; at least 2 in the implementation.
对 RSI 序列做随机指标时的窗口。: Window for applying the stochastic formula to the RSI series.
两个操作数逐根相减。: Subtracts two operands bar by bar.
按 ATR 画出的跟踪止损线，价格在线上方为多头、下方为空头。: An ATR-based trailing stop line: price above it is bullish, below is bearish.
